program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    rbounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    regions = []
    for ri in range(len(rbounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = rbounds[ri]+1, rbounds[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(cbounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = cbounds[ci]+1, cbounds[ci+1]
            tile = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
            if any(v != bg for row in tile for v in row):
                regions.append((r0,r1,c0,c1,tile))
    if not regions:
        return grid
    sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1,source = regions[0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri in range(len(rbounds)-1):
        r0,r1 = rbounds[ri]+1,rbounds[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(cbounds)-1):
            c0,c1 = cbounds[ci]+1,cbounds[ci+1]
            if (r0,r1,c0,c1)==(sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1) or (r1-r0,c1-c0)!=(len(source),len(source[0])):
                continue
            for r in range(r1-r0):
                for c in range(c1-c0):
                    out[r0+r][c0+c] = source[r][c]
    return out
'''
